projectContext: Sprint 22 addresses critical coverage gaps in untested/undertested modules. Key targets: Pexels API client (0 tests, 356 LOC), chapter detection multi-pass system (0 tests, 1,811 LOC), fallback pattern routing edge cases, LLM provider validation/hallucination detection, tiered matcher strategy selection, multi-factor scoring edge cases, post-edit analysis feedback loop, and audio/face detection threshold boundaries. Sprint 13-21 established ~190 stories of test coverage. This sprint focuses on module-level coverage rather than cross-module coordination (Sprint 21 focus).
